policies.description: Define when consultation with the National Data Management Office is required, identify responsible roles, require consultation before relevant action is taken, and specify how the consultation outcome must be documented.

policies.name: Data Transfer and Hosting Review Policy
policies.description: Require review of proposed data hosting, storage, processing, or movement activities for potential data-localization implications and require referral to the National Data Management Office where applicable.

documents.name: Data Localization Assessment and Referral Procedure
documents.description: Document the steps for assessing a proposed activity, determining whether National Data Management Office consultation is needed, submitting the referral, obtaining the response, and approving or rejecting the proposed action.

documents.name: Data Localization Consultation Register
documents.description: Maintain a register of referrals to the National Data Management Office, including the requesting entity, activity reviewed, referral date, consultation outcome, conditions, decision, and approving authority.

documents.name: Data Processing and Hosting Inventory
documents.description: Maintain an inventory of relevant data sets and associated hosting, storage, processing, and movement arrangements to support data-localization assessments.

evidence.name: National Data Management Office Consultation Records
evidence.description: Copies of referrals, correspondence, responses, decisions, and any conditions received from the National Data Management Office regarding data localization.

evidence.name: Completed Data Localization Assessments
evidence.description: Approved assessments showing that proposed activities were evaluated for localization implications before action was taken.

evidence.name: Pre-Action Approval Records
evidence.description: Workflow approvals or sign-offs demonstrating that the required consultation and review were completed before the relevant activity commenced.
